designReview.note: Design artifacts carry no approval field. Review state lives in a separate digest-bound record so that updating a review never mutates the reviewed artifact.

operationalComparatorUse.note: Permission would require a repository-recorded, digest-bound operational review record. That is not authenticated reviewer identity and cannot approve model compatibility, runtime enforcement, or acceptance.

crossDimensionalInvariants.invariant: Operational permission never enables runtime enforcement.
Runtime enforcement never implies formal acceptance.
A superseded design cannot remain operationally permitted without an explicit defined transition.
Every approval or permission binds the exact artifact digest it reviewed.
Gate 2A-P artifacts remain non-approved and non-operational until separately reviewed.
A review record that records a completed review must represent that review truthfully rather than as not having occurred.
Whether the obligation decomposition is semantically complete and genuinely independent.
